title: IMP-0019 shadow rotation advisor on real local run telemetry (offline, advice only)
summary: The supervisor ran `agent.py orchestrate rotation-advisor` over the real local orchestrator home: 22 runs, 606 workers, 737 calls (724 with exact usage, 13 without usage excluded), 5,920 events, 0 malformed lines. Shadow mode, so dispatch was never changed. The advisor would rotate to a fresh episode for 2.81% of eligible workers (17). Modeled worker input cost falls from 288.8M to 269.5M token-cost units if its advice were followed (-6.7%). Per rotated worker the predicted saving is a median 1.05M (p90 1.77M, max 3.42M). Break-even boundaries fall at the first episode boundary for implementer, repairer and test_author, and the second for planner. Aggregates only; no prompt or transcript text in the output. Orchestrator workers cannot read run telemetry outside their worktree, so the supervisor ran this host step. Next: keep shadow mode while more runs accumulate, and cross-check against IMP-0018 Phase 1 (shared prefix), which lowers the per-worker bootstrap cost the model assumes.
